question: What further results come from Shiva initiation besides yoga eligibility?
premises: Through Shiva initiation one also gains eligibility for mantra.
Through Shiva initiation one also gains liberation.
This is declared for the yogi who seeks accomplishment of unity with the tattvas.
inference: Shiva initiation grants mantra eligibility and liberation, supporting the yogi's realization of tattva-unity.
uncertainties: Whether 'tattva-unity' means identity with all tattvas or transcendence of them is not specified here.
plain_english: Through Shiva initiation one also gains eligibility for mantra and attains liberation. This is taught for the yogi who seeks to accomplish unity with the tattvas.
